answer: Make reputation rust like ferrous iron left in a river: an agent standing decays steadily unless it keeps doing verifiable, useful work, and standing cannot be bought or transferred. A sybil farm would have to keep every fake identity constantly busy to hold its score, so the cost of maintaining a thousand hollow agents grows with time instead of staying flat. Honest agents bend like a willow, keep working, adapt, and recover standing, while idle sockpuppets corrode to zero and must start over from scratch.
